reason.unknown: The companion refused this for a reason it has no sentence for yet: {token}.
profile.chat_qa.name: Chat Q&A
profile.chat_qa.description: Answers a chat message that mentions the companion's name.
profile.channel_points.name: Channel points
profile.channel_points.description: Reacts when a viewer redeems one custom reward you choose.
profile.spoken_keyword.name: Spoken keyword
profile.spoken_keyword.description: Listens to your microphone and answers when you say the wake word.
profile.silent.name: Silent
profile.silent.description: Connects to your channel's chat but never answers: every trigger is off.
instance.already_running: The companion is already running for this profile; opening it: {url}
instance.version_mismatch: Another version of the companion is already running for this profile: version {running} is running, and this launch is version {own}. Nothing was opened.
instance.version_mismatch.next: Close the running companion window and launch again, or open the running one manually at {url}
instance.record_exists: An instance record exists for this profile: {path}
instance.port.unauthenticated: Its recorded port {port} answers, but the check with the record's access token did not succeed.
instance.port.silent: Its recorded port {port} did not answer within 10 seconds.
instance.not_confirmed.cause: The companion that wrote the record may still be starting or stopping, or another program now uses that port, so this launch started nothing.
instance.not_confirmed.next: Use the companion window if one is open; otherwise wait and launch again, and if this report repeats, close the program holding process {pid} or restart the computer.
instance.unconfirmable: Its process {pid} is running but not answering to this launch: this platform cannot confirm that it is the companion, so this launch started nothing.
instance.unconfirmable.next: Use the companion window if one is open, on 127.0.0.1 port {port}; otherwise close the program holding process {pid} or restart the computer.
instance.stale: An earlier instance of the companion did not stop cleanly; its instance record was removed.
instance.unusable: The instance record {path} could not be read or written, so the companion did not start.
instance.unusable.next: Keep the profile on a local disk you can write to, then launch again.
